dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Ah, life is great when everything is nice and calm...

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Hm? I'm here to maintain order at the port.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: To be honest, this port is very safe, and there aren't many issues. The most dangerous thing that has happened so far was a dispute between the captains of two cargo ships about who should enter the port first.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: One of the captains let their emotions get the better of them, and jumped directly from their own ship's mast to confront the other captain.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Needless to say, everyone was pretty startled, and in the end, Ms. Cassigneul herself had to step in to mediate.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: You should've seen how far that captain leaped. Are all sailors that strong?

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Goodbye, and I wish you peaceful days ahead.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: I remember one of the ships was a tea clipper from Liyue, and the other was carrying spices from Sumeru.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Speaking of tea, I've heard that there's a delicacy in Liyue where they boil a bird's egg and then crack part of the shell.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Once they've done that, they soak it in tea along with various seasonings. The egg absorbs the aroma of the tea and produces a unique and layered flavor.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: I wonder if there are any clever minds in Fontaine that can replicate this delicacy. I'd really like to taste it.

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Umm... How exactly did I win again?

dialogues.speaker: Chourei
dialogues.text: Uhh... How did I lose so suddenly?
